post.text: Fire and Emergency New Zealand @FireEmergencyNZ Jul 12, 2023 Ngā mihi o te tau hou, happy new year! Our people are celebrating the Māori New Year and the appearance of Puanga and Matariki in the sky! We're reflecting on the past and giving thanks to the stars as we look towards the future. 📷: Whānau in Tairāwhiti at their hautapu today.
